body.name: Green-aligned multiscale product-Hellinger alternatives
body.construction: Set \(\varepsilon_n=n^{-\eta}\). For \(g=g_\star\), define \[f_{n,\pm,g_\star}=f_{0g_\star}\left(1\pm\frac{\zeta\,\ell_{\varepsilon_n,g_\star}}{\sqrt n\,\lVert\ell_{\varepsilon_n,g_\star}\rVert_{L^2(P_{0g_\star})}}\right),\] and for every \(g\neq g_\star\) set \(f_{n,\pm,g}=f_{0g}\); let \(P_{n,+}\) and \(P_{n,-}\) be the corresponding four-law tuples.
